title: Opposite of a fixed cocone category and colimit-limit duality
statement:
Use coherent diagrams, cone/cocone categories, initial/terminal objects and universes of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], opposites and their mapping-space equivalences from clause (4) of [lem-coef-infinity-relative-cone-equivalence], and the internal-functor reversal of [lem-coef-infinity-cocone-opposite-join-functor]. Let $K$ be a small simplicial set, $\mathcal E$ a quasicategory in a containing universe, and $F:K\to\mathcal E$ a fixed diagram. Write $D=\operatorname{Fun}(K,\mathcal E)$, $D'=\operatorname{Fun}(K^{\mathrm{op}},\mathcal E^{\mathrm{op}})$, and $F^o=F^{\mathrm{op}}$. There is a natural simplicial isomorphism
$$\bigl(\{F\}\times_{D,\operatorname{ev}_0}\operatorname{Fun}(\Delta^1,D)\times_{\operatorname{ev}_1,D}\mathcal E\bigr)^{\mathrm{op}}\cong\mathcal E^{\mathrm{op}}\times_{D',\operatorname{ev}_0}\operatorname{Fun}(\Delta^1,D')\times_{\operatorname{ev}_1,D'}\{F^o\},$$
where the maps from $\mathcal E$ and $\mathcal E^{\mathrm{op}}$ are the constant-diagram maps. The isomorphism reverses the parameter simplex and the interval, exchanges endpoint evaluations, and commutes with apex evaluation. On vertices it sends $\lambda:F\to\Delta_Kx$ to $\lambda^o:\Delta_{K^{\mathrm{op}}}x\to F^o$. Under this isomorphism, $\lambda$ is colimiting (initial in its fixed-$F$ cocone category) if and only if $\lambda^o$ is limiting (terminal in its fixed-$F^o$ cone category). The induced mapping-space equivalences identify outgoing spaces from $\lambda$ with incoming spaces to $\lambda^o$, naturally in the other cocone; their contractibility is equivalent. The assertions include $K=\varnothing$ and require no other colimits or limits in $\mathcal E$.

source.place: Construction 1.4.2.2 (opposite simplicial set); Remark 7.1.6.2 in https://kerodon.net/tag/02KF for limit/colimit duality. The displayed fixed coherent comma-category isomorphism is agent-formulated from def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones, not attributed to the sharp relative-cone definition. Read online 2026-10-17; archival copies WANTED. Kerodon identifiers, not Stacks tags.
